page.layout: One page of text, verse emblems in a single column; running head at top; page number top left; marginal scribbles and manuscript marks in the margins (not transcribed); a marginal note at the right edge partly cut off.

main_text.head: Obtrectator se, non alios vrit.
main_text.p:
Veste geris prunas: quid agis? citus abiice: vestis
Vritur, haud prunas enecat illa tuas.
Dignos laude viros carpis qui dente maligno,
Define: te, non hos vrere, stulte, potes.
main_text.head: Errore uno perempto aly tolluntur.
main_text.p:
Castra Philistæis conferta Phalangibus olim
Dauidis vnius sunt superata manu.
Et quæ turrito fuerant elata gigante,
Vnius extincti pressa fuere nece.
Errorem si fax veri discusserit vnum,
Errorum fugiet consociata cohors.
main_text.head: Mundo dediti & irretiti.
main_text.p:
Implicat iste pedes sinuosis retibus, unde
Post nequit implicitos expicuisse pedes.
Huic similes viuunt, vani quos devia mundi
Impediunt, nunquam se quibus expediant.
main_text.head: Cicadæ. Concupiscentia obtemperantes.
main_text.p:
Vt streperæ verno pascuntur rore cicadæ,
Quo tandem, rupto ventre, crepare solent:
Sic desideriis quisquis se tradit, iisdem
Dum nutritur, alit femina certa necis.
main_text.head: Nulla virtus perfecta. Ex Ioanne Climaco.
main_text.p:
Vndam de liquidis fontibus hauriens,
Ranam de medio tuli fluente:
Quæ puro fluitans sordida Cymbio,
Rauco visa mihi est sono profari:

page.notes: Manuscript marks and pen strokes in the margins and the handwritten "Cum" at lower right are not printed text. Right-edge fragments of a neighbouring page are show-through and were omitted. Lines of the last stanza are partly obscured by stains; the final lines below "Rauco visa..." are illegible in the scan and are omitted.
